hook.text: A neural network learned to compress images better than JPEG in 2018. Machines are now designing codecs.

buildup.text: Neural compression uses autoencoders that learn to compress and reconstruct data end-to-end.

discovery.text: The network discovers perceptual features automatically—no hand-crafted transforms like DCT needed.

twist.text: Training is expensive and decoding is slow. Classical codecs still win on speed and standardization.

climax.text: Hybrid approaches combine neural insights with classical frameworks, getting the best of both worlds.

punchline.text: Machines learning to compress. The next frontier.

quiz.question: What advantage do neural compressors have over classical codecs?
options: They use fewer bits than entropy allows
